hero.subtext: A few minutes of your time is all we need to start building your case.

footer.text: Every submission is reviewed by a real person, never sold to a third party.

stepCase.title: About your case
stepCase.subtitle: A quick overview so we route your case to the right team.
stepCase.attorneyLabel: Do you currently have an attorney?

stepContact.title: Contact information
stepContact.subtitle: So our intake team can reach you. We keep this confidential.
stepContact.firstNameError: Enter a valid first name (letters only).
stepContact.lastNameError: Enter a valid last name (letters only).

stepAccident.title: What happened
stepAccident.subtitle: Walk us through the accident in your own words. Details help us evaluate your case accurately.
stepAccident.dateError: Enter a valid date, not in the future.
stepAccident.policeLabel: Did police respond to the scene?
stepAccident.descriptionError: Please share at least a full sentence (10+ characters).
stepAccident.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. It was raining heavily and visibility was poor when...

stepInjuries.title: Injuries
stepInjuries.subtitle: Add yourself and anyone else in the vehicle who was injured.
stepInjuries.invalidMessage: Enter at least a name or a description for this person.

stepReview.title: Review your case
stepReview.subtitle: Please confirm everything looks correct before submitting.
stepReview.consentText: By checking this box, I agree to be contacted by phone, text, or email regarding my potential case. Message and data rates may apply. This does not create an attorney-client relationship.
stepReview.attachmentsHint: Photos of the accident, a police report, or medical records. Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, or PDF, up to 15MB each.
stepReview.uploadPartialError: Your case was submitted, but {count} file(s) failed to upload. You can email them to us instead.

successPanel.title: Your case has been received
successPanel.message: A member of our intake team will call you at the best time you selected. Keep your phone nearby, most callers hear from us within a few hours.

metadata.title: Free Confidential Case Review
metadata.description: Tell us what happened in a few minutes and our team will review your case at no cost and with no obligation.
